protocol.lam_rule: lambda (and, per rule, the threshold) by held-out quality of each support image

note: fully closed-form ridge over EVERY support pixel (per-image Gram matrices; gram_mode says whether they were formed per pixel or exactly on the patch grids): raw coarse + fine DINOv3 and the 35 native priors. per_image = the primary <variant>_<rule>; alt = every variant x rule. Rules: iou = lambda and cut by held-out mean IoU over a threshold grid; cl = centreline-sensitivity x pixel-precision proxy; fix = lambda by held-out IoU at the cut 0.5; mse = lambda by exact held-out (weighted) squared error, cut 0.5; zero = lambda of iou, cut 0.5. Variants: plain (every pixel weight 1), bal (classes equal total weight). No gradient step anywhere.
